interest: Shows Grew consulting Washington on diplomatic precedence rules before a Tokyo protocol vote.
overview: Telegram (1937): Grew asks Washington's rules on ranking foreign ministers against the Under Secretary and retired US envoys, to guide his vote at a Tokyo diplomatic-corps protocol meeting.

subfiles.about: A Department of State document file note cross-referencing Ambassador Grew's telegram no. 65 on diplomatic precedence to file 811.452/154.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to Telegram 65: Grew asks Washington's precedence rules for foreign ministers versus the Under Secretary and retired US envoys.
subfiles.title: Document File Note on Tokyo Telegram No. 65 Regarding Diplomatic Precedence

subfiles.about: An urgent telegram from Ambassador Joseph C. Grew requesting Washington's guidance on diplomatic precedence to determine how to vote in a Tokyo diplomatic corps meeting.
subfiles.summary: Grew asks Washington's rules on precedence for foreign ministers versus the Under Secretary and retired US envoys.
subfiles.title: Telegram No. 65 from Ambassador Grew to the Secretary of State on Diplomatic Precedence
